rule: Sam, 2026-11-17, relayed by COBIx on #3358 section 2: collect with gaps noted and confidence scores; Commons Clarity's Part B (#3480, comment 6967374303); COBIx's D2 decision (major total differs, about 30); Sam's routine prompt of 2026-11-25, as the S739 conductor's brief carries it: a record held for a gap is collected with its gap named and a lower score on the 0-100 bar, never held, unless the record is not the program's own; S739: East Los Angeles's records kb/receipts/program_requirement_records_piles_s720_ela_2026-11-24_s720e.json held, read again by key: passed by a rescore where today's scorer's one reading moves them, else collected with their gaps named where the record is the program's own (no reread, no reconcile)

gaps.noted_figures_differ: The reader's notes quote two figures from the catalog page that disagree, and the record's units add to one and state the other; no page read has settled which the program requires.

held.why: held: unit_line_not_read is true of it (its note: the Required Core's 48-50 includes 'Completion of Intermediate Algebra or its equivalent or higher Math course 3-5', a line with no course; with it the 45 is the printed 48-50), and it is on no proved live run: its live row sits on an older extraction than the committed record, the free reconcile 45176404274's (on_live_run). A reread that posts that record, then the gap
held: its movement-based list reads three courses at up to 4 units (major 20-33 against 20-27): a reread
held: its arithmetic reads 'unstated' (0 units per noncredit course, no hours), which the Commons counts passing once posted: no gap
held: the low end reads 39 against the printed 41-45, a sequence read one course short: a reread

records.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units
records.words: The last block's heading says 'COMPLETE FOUR UNITS' but prints '2-3' as its block total; minimum recorded as 4 from the heading, stated as printed 2-3. Printed block totals 8+2+3+(2-3)+4 sum to the printed 19-20, suggesting the '2-3' is a misprint.

before_image.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units

outcomes: Recognize applications of music theory via analysis and performance.
Perform assigned repertoire at a polished level.
Employ appropriate technologies and contextual knowledge in the production and marketing of commercial music.

blocks.name: COMPLETE THE FOLLOWING FOUR REQUIRED COURSES
COMPLETE TWO UNITS FROM THE FOLLOWING (COURSES MAY BE REPEATED)
COMPLETE THREE UNITS FROM THE FOLLOWING (ONE CLASS FROM THE FOLLOWING COURSES)
COMPLETE TWO TO THREE UNITS FROM THE FOLLOWING (ONE CLASS FROM THE FOLLOWING COURSES)
COMPLETE FOUR UNITS FROM THE FOLLOWING (DEPENDING ON THE AREA OF INTEREST)

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score (a passing row: checks.arithmetic to equal); checks.coverage, invented and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found, and a course an entry says the printed total leaves out on neither it nor the state's list. A note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.
